adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, the booking query includes `user: { include: { credentials: true } }` (so organizer credentials are available on `booking.user.credentials`), but the code later builds the `EventManager` using `getUsersCredentials(ctx.user)` and spreads `...user` where `user` is the *caller* (`ctx.user`), not the booking organizer. Since the mutation explicitly allows non-organizers (`isAttendee` / team admin/owner) to add guests, this can result in the calendar update being attempted with the wrong account’s credentials (`eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees(evt, booking)`), plausibly failing to update the organizer’s external calendar event when the caller lacks the organizer’s calendar credentials.
